status: Boundary fields implement existing ruling; internal deltas await the narrow design checkpoint, not production schemas

fields.semantics: Hints only. Resolve server head and k before writes. Unknown step, stale base and narrowed start are existing 409 REVISION_CONFLICT subreasons. READY with explicit current step is an intentional mixed-mode re-learn.

add.baseRevisionId: optional UUID; present iff incremental base exists
add.firstLearnStepId: optional UUID; present with baseRevisionId, immutable requested/server-resolved initial boundary

fields.invariants: Both present or both absent; step exists in current sourceSteps; base same test/CSI; client cannot mutate. Full first learn remains omitted.

add.relearnedFrom: required nullable closed object {stepId: UUID, driftSwitchStepId?: UUID}

fields.semantics: null for no actual re-learn; stepId is effective first learned step. On drift stepId == driftSwitchStepId == j, while session firstLearnStepId remains original k. Nonnull does not imply publication succeeded.

add.stepSnapshotHashes: required object, maxProperties 100, UUID property names, values lowercase hex64
add.reusedFrom: required object, maxProperties 100, UUID property names, values closed {revisionId:UUID,stepId:UUID}

fields.invariants: Exact authored step coverage. reusedFrom keys subset of hashes, value.stepId equals key, same-test/CSI base and equal hash. Full learn reusedFrom={}. Hash computation ignores these two maps when projecting learned action content, avoiding recursion.
Equal frozen DB columns and artifact.learnedPlan fields; learnedPlanHash already commits them, so no redundant RevisionIdentity hash field or generation bump is necessary.

fields.hold: Review V15 closed publicReceipt SQL shape and forward-update guard in V21; do not merely change JSON schema.

fields.semantics: Server projection only; full checklist remains. Model may propose only uncompleted suffix obligations; authoritative validator enforces same fence, not prompt text alone.

fields.requiredShapeBeforeImplementation: Pin {baseRevisionId, stepId, coordinate, operationHash, guard} to the verified base and current prefix cursor. Keep model-facing Action and ledger evidence closed and current-session scoped. Reuse existing prepare route; freeze exact placement after reviewed adapter preparation factoring.

fields.requiredBeforeImplementation: R3 and R5 need exact closed records, version joins and no-effect proof semantics before C3b/V21; they are not implicitly covered by the public boundary fields.

hashRules.canonical: GuidedContracts.canonical, canonical-v1; sorted ASCII keys, exact text/no normalization, JSON safe integers, lowercase hex SHA-256 UTF-8
hashRules.inputChain: {domain:"studio.step-chain",version:1,stepId,stepInputHash,previous}; previous=configHash at first step, otherwise previous chain hash
hashRules.learnedContentEnvelope: {actions:[ordered action content],producedBindings:[producer-local definitions],consumedBindings:[semantic edges owned by this consumer step]}; exact A4 proposed ruling in ruling-deltas-and-remediation.json, awaiting PO/Dara
hashRules.denyListRule: A4 explicitly relocates consumers out of producer-local definitions into consumer-owned semantic edges. Apart from that structural attribution, remove only these exact ephemeral paths; every other semantic field is committed.
hashRules.stableIds: Prefix authored inputId/bindingId retained only after verifying base recipe/allocation identity; all new receipts and availability remain this session.
hashRules.validation: Java computes and rechecks from frozen base/draft; TS pure validator verifies merged exact graph and new fields. PostgreSQL V15 verifies coverage and reuse equality; vector parity includes Java/TS/SQL canonical-v1.
